why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://app.grass.io   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: Create an account at app.grass.io with an email address or Google account.
Install the app from grass.io/download . There are builds for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.

Leave it running on a stable residential connection and keep the app updated. Grass says such nodes are more likely to get traffic. Warning Using a VPN to get around Grass's country restrictions can lead to permanent disqualification.
If you ran Grass during Stage 2, open the dashboard and claim your USDC before 22 January 2027. Warning Grass keeps whatever is unclaimed after 22 January 2027.
